decision_local_entry_metric.occupancy_or_exit_assumption: none; this is whole-path entry quality and does not manufacture an exit
decision_local_entry_metric.training_reference_distributions: market-phase empirical distributions from the outer-training role only, frozen before outer validation

component_transform.dual_unit_arbitration: minimum of dollar and return transformed values

family_aggregation.within_horizon: equal mean of non-timestamp registered metrics after dual-unit arbitration
family_aggregation.across_horizons: equal mean over applicable valid registered horizons
family_aggregation.quality_family_score: equal mean within each of early_drawdown, time_to_first_real_profit, pre_profit_adverse_excursion, underwater_burden, profitable_window_stability
family_aggregation.whole_path_quality_Q: equal mean of the five quality-family scores
family_aggregation.insufficient_family: a BUY with any of the five quality families unavailable is invalid and cannot be selected or scored

time_to_first_profit_scoring.no_event: worst transformed event-time value for that horizon
time_to_first_profit_scoring.first_profit_size: higher is better with dual-unit arbitration

decision_local_entry_metric.profitable_window_count_rule: when fraction_positive is zero the count component takes the worst value; otherwise fewer runs are better because equal profitable time in fewer runs is more stable

p5_comparison.benchmark: P5 VWAP-side nearest-ATM under its frozen historical rule
p5_comparison.role: mandatory benchmark only; never an upstream filter, label, feature, or final architecture
identical_safety: same D49 causal daily budget state where serial state is relevant
same entry ask and 3 dollar fee primitives
p5_comparison.wait_accounting: P5 WAIT and learned WAIT each receive Q=0 and U=0; WAIT rows remain in every denominator
p5_comparison.fixed_exit_economics: report-only if retained; cannot pass the entry gate or replace whole-path quality

ordered_terms.maximize: one-sided 80 percent moving-block-bootstrap lower bound of mean paired DeltaQ_session versus P5
one-sided 80 percent moving-block-bootstrap lower bound of mean paired DeltaU_session versus P5
minimum of the five quality-family lower bounds

ordered_terms.minimize: measured inference latency then materialized bytes, without changing the scientific contract

inner_loop_objective.trade_frequency: diagnostic and joint-calibration target only; no hard trades-per-day objective or cap
inner_loop_objective.final_outer_evidence: defined in FT2-11, not optimized here

resampling_noise_and_plateau.comparison: candidate minus current incumbent on the same inner OOF sessions
real_improvement_requires: one-sided 80 percent lower bound for DeltaQ(candidate-incumbent) strictly greater than zero
one-sided 80 percent lower bound for DeltaU(candidate-incumbent) greater than or equal to zero
no quality-family point estimate is negative
all machinery and mandatory controls remain valid

plateau_counter.failed_or_incomplete_trial: does not reset and counts only if it consumed a registered serious-trial slot

resampling_noise_and_plateau.scope: search guidance only; these 80 percent bounds are not final scientific acceptance

no_reward_hacking: no absolute PnL objective for entry training
no label or metric selected after outer results
no family may be removed because it hurts results
no fixed-exit profit may substitute for whole-path quality
no P5 opportunity filtering of the learned action space
no outer validation feedback into model, composer, calibration, or stopping
